verses.1: And immediately, after they had appointed a council of elders, along with the priests and secretaries, they arrested Jesus and handed Him over to Pilate.
verses.2: And Pilate asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” He replied, “You say so.”
verses.3: And the high priests accused him of many things.
verses.4: And Pilate once again asked him, saying, “Do you not answer anything? See how many charges they have against you.”
verses.5: But Jesus said nothing anymore, so that Pilate could marvel at him.
verses.6: On the Sabbath day, he gave them a piece of cloth as a gift.
verses.7: And the man known as Barabbas was tied up with the stakes, so that he could be executed in that position.
verses.8: And as soon as the crowd started to complain about what they were doing, they began to criticize them.
verses.9: But Pilate replied to them, “Do you want me to release the king of the Jews?”
verses.10: For they realized that it was through envy that the high priests had abandoned him.
verses.11: But the high priests urged the crowd to force Barabbas to be released for them.
verses.12: And Pilate once again replied to them, “What do you want me to do with the king of the Jews?”
verses.13: And once again, they cried out: “Be crucified!”
verses.14: But Pilate said to them, “What has he done to deserve this?” They became even more angry and demanded that he be crucified.
verses.15: But Pilate, wanting to do what the crowd demanded, released Barabbas for them. He also handed Jesus over to be crucified.
verses.16: The soldiers captured him behind the temple; it’s a place of worship. They gathered everyone together there.
verses.17: And they adorn him with pearls, and wrap around him a wreath of beautiful flowers.
verses.18: And they began to fight against him. Happy you, king of the Jews!
verses.19: And they also carefully placed his head in the cup, and watered him properly. Then, they bent their knees in front of him.
verses.20: And when they had sung to him, they removed his crown and put on him his own clothes. Then they brought him out so that they could crucify him.
verses.21: And they will also bring along someone from Simon the Cyrene, who comes from the countryside. This person is Alexander’s father and Rufus’. They will go to carry out his crucifixion.
verses.22: And they will carry him to the place called Golgotha, which is the place where Christ was crucified.
verses.23: And they gave him wine, which he refused to drink.
verses.24: And they also crucify him; they divide up his clothes, putting coins on them for each person.
verses.25: It was a third hour, and they also circumcised him.
verses.26: And the reason for his punishment was clearly written down: “King of the Jews.”
verses.27: And with him, two robbers are also crucified; one from the right side, and one from the left side.
verses.29: And those who were nearby also shook their heads and said, “No! He who has been building this ship in three days…”
verses.31: Similarly, the high priests also conspired with each other, along with the secretaries. They said, “He has saved others, but he himself cannot be saved.”
verses.32: The King of Israel, Jesus Christ, now descends from the cross, so that we may see and believe in Him. And those who were crucified with Him also saw Him.
verses.33: And at the sixth hour, darkness covered the entire earth, until the ninth hour.
verses.34: And at that time, Jesus spoke with a loud voice: “Elohim elohim lemá sabachthani!” It means, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.35: And when some of those who were present heard this, they said, “Look, Elyana is speaking.”
verses.36: And someone else, filled with greed, asked him, “Let’s see if Elyas is coming to take him away.”
verses.37: And Jesus, after that, uttered a loud voice.
verses.38: And the floor of the temple was split into two parts, from top to bottom.
verses.39: Seeing that the centurion stood against him, saying that he had died in such a manner, he said, “Indeed, this man was the son of God.”
verses.40: And there were also women who seemed distant from us. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary of Jacob the younger, Joseph’s mother, and Salome.
verses.41: When they were in Galilee, they followed him and obeyed him. Many others also went with him to Jerusalem.
verses.42: And since it has already been seen, and since it was prepared, then it is the first day.
verses.43: Jesus, who came from Jerusalem as a wise and influential leader, and who himself was willing to accept the kingdom of God, dared to go before Pilate and reveal the true identity of Jesus.
verses.44: But Pilate wondered whether he had already died. So, after inviting the centurion, he asked him when he had died.
verses.45: And a necklace was also given by the centurion to Joseph.
verses.46: And after he had collected the sand, he carried him into the tomb. He placed him in a tomb that was carved out of stone. Then he placed a stone over the entrance to the tomb.
verses.47: And Mary Magdalene and Mary of Zion saw where she was placed.
